parser_method: pypdf page-by-page text extraction; identity checked against library_master
identity_confirmation_basis: inventory matched plus first-author and year confirmed on first PDF page; library_master title is malformed or noncanonical
extraction_limitations: Multi-column order, equations and embedded glyphs may require PDF cross-check.
Section boundaries are best-effort and require scientific-reading review.
No figure digitization or bulk image extraction was performed.
